about_the_game:
🚀 Space Revolver
A Strategic Puzzle Adventure Utilizing Gravity and Map Rotation

Space Revolver is a strategic puzzle game set aboard a space station. Players take on the role of a trainee who must solve increasingly complex puzzles using simple controls. By rotating the map and toggling gravity, players must navigate through challenging environments that test both creativity and logic.

🔑 Key Features

  • 🌀 Gravity Manipulation & Map Rotation: Redefine spatial awareness by altering gravity and rotating the environment.

  • 🧠 Evolving Puzzle Design: Start with intuitive challenges that gradually require logical deduction and strategic planning.

  • 🔧 Five Core Controls: Move left/right, rotate the map left/right, and toggle gravity on/off to find optimal solutions.

  • 🌌 Retro Pixel Art with Sci-Fi Aesthetics: Experience a unique visual style combining classic pixel art with futuristic effects.

🎮 Gameplay Overview

  • Basic Controls: Left/Right Movement, Map Rotation (Left/Right), Gravity Toggle (On/Off)

  • Obstacles & Mechanics: Lasers, spikes, electric blocks, switches, movable boxes, ON/OFF blocks

  • Playstyle: Limited moves encourage efficient problem-solving and multiple solution paths, embodying the "Easy to Learn, Hard to Master" philosophy.

📌 Development Background

Originating from Krafton's Jungle Game Lab, Space Revolver evolved from a game jam concept into a commercial title through extensive feedback and iteration. Developed by a dedicated two-person team, the game has been showcased at various events, continually refining its gameplay and content.

🎯 How creatively can you solve puzzles with minimal moves?
